author: 曹雪芹
description_zh: 中国古典四大名著之一，以贾宝玉、林黛玉、薛宝钗的爱情悲剧为主线，描绘了封建贵族家庭的兴衰史。
description_en: One of China's Four Great Classical Novels, depicting the tragic love story of Jia Baoyu, Lin Daiyu and Xue Baochai, and the rise and fall of an aristocratic family.

author: 老舍
description_zh: 描写北京人力车夫祥子三起三落的悲惨人生，揭示了旧中国底层人民的苦难命运。
description_en: A tragic story of a Beijing rickshaw puller's rise and fall, revealing the suffering of common people in old China.

author: 老舍
description_zh: 以北京裕泰茶馆为背景，通过三个历史时期展现半个世纪的社会变迁。
description_en: Set in a Beijing teahouse, depicting half a century of social changes through three historical periods.

author: 老舍
description_zh: 描写北京小羊圈胡同祁家四代人在抗日战争中的生活与抗争。
description_en: Depicting four generations of the Qi family in a Beijing hutong during the Japanese occupation.

author: 林海音
description_zh: 以小女孩英子的视角回忆老北京的人和事，充满童真与怀旧之情。
description_en: A nostalgic memoir of old Beijing through the eyes of a young girl named Yingzi.

author: 沈从文
description_zh: 描绘湘西边城茶峒的淳朴风情，讲述翠翠与傩送的爱情悲剧。
description_en: A pastoral love story set in the border town of Chadong in western Hunan.

author: 鲁迅
description_zh: 鲁迅的第一部小说集，包括《狂人日记》《阿Q正传》等经典作品。
description_en: Lu Xun's first collection of short stories, including 'A Madman's Diary' and 'The True Story of Ah Q'.

author: 鲁迅
description_zh: 鲁迅回忆童年和青年时期的散文集，文笔温馨细腻。
description_en: Lu Xun's collection of memoirs about his childhood and youth.

author: 鲁迅
description_zh: 鲁迅以现代视角重新演绎中国古代神话传说和历史故事。
description_en: Lu Xun's modern reinterpretation of ancient Chinese myths and historical stories.

author: 老舍
description_zh: 老舍未完成的自传体小说，描写清末旗人家庭的生活。
description_en: Lao She's unfinished autobiographical novel about a Manchu Banner family in late Qing Dynasty.

author: 茅盾
description_zh: 以1930年代上海为背景，描写民族资本家吴荪甫的兴衰史。
description_en: Set in 1930s Shanghai, depicting the rise and fall of national capitalist Wu Sunfu.

author: 周而复
description_zh: 描写上海解放后民族资本家的社会主义改造历程。
description_en: Depicting the socialist transformation of Shanghai's capitalists after liberation.

author: 韩邦庆
description_zh: 描绘晚清上海青楼女子的生活百态，开创吴语方言小说先河。
description_en: Depicting the lives of Shanghai courtesans in late Qing, pioneering Wu dialect fiction.

author: 张爱玲
description_zh: 以香港沦陷为背景，讲述白流苏与范柳原的爱情故事。
description_en: A love story between Bai Liusu and Fan Liuyuan set against the fall of Hong Kong.

author: 张爱玲
description_zh: 描写被黄金枷锁禁锢一生的曹七巧的悲剧命运。
description_en: The tragic story of Cao Qiqiao, trapped by her golden shackles throughout her life.

author: 张爱玲
description_zh: 讲述沈世钧与顾曼桢错失半生的爱情悲剧。
description_en: A tragic love story of Shen Shijun and Gu Manzhen who miss each other for half their lives.

author: 张爱玲
description_zh: 探讨男人心中情人与妻子的永恒矛盾。
description_en: Exploring the eternal conflict between a mistress and a wife in a man's heart.

author: 王安忆
description_zh: 描绘上海小姐王琦瑶跨越四十年的人生命运。
description_en: Depicting forty years in the life of Shanghai beauty Wang Qiyao.

author: 金宇澄
description_zh: 用沪语书写的上海故事，交织六七十年代与九十年代的城市记忆。
description_en: Shanghai stories written in Wu dialect, weaving memories of the 1960s-70s and 1990s.

author: 陈文平
description_zh: 描写民国时期上海滩黑帮风云与传奇故事。
description_en: Depicting the legendary gangster stories of Republican-era Shanghai.

author: 陈忠实
description_zh: 描绘关中平原白鹿村两大家族半个世纪的恩怨情仇。
description_en: An epic depicting the feuds between two families in Bailu Village on the Guanzhong Plain over half a century.

author: 路遥
description_zh: 描写陕北农村孙少安、孙少平兄弟的奋斗人生。
description_en: Depicting the struggles of brothers Sun Shao'an and Sun Shaoping in rural northern Shaanxi.

author: 路遥
description_zh: 描写农村青年高加林在城乡之间的人生抉择与命运沉浮。
description_en: Depicting rural youth Gao Jialin's life choices between urban and rural worlds.

author: 贾平凹
description_zh: 以西安为背景，描写作家庄之蝶的精神困境与都市生活。
description_en: Set in Xi'an, depicting writer Zhuang Zhidie's spiritual crisis and urban life.

author: 贾平凹
description_zh: 以秦腔为线索，描写关中农村的变迁与衰落。
description_en: Using Qinqiang opera as a thread, depicting the changes and decline of rural Guanzhong.

author: 贾平凹
description_zh: 描写文革时期陕西乡村的动荡与人性。
description_en: Depicting the turbulence and human nature in rural Shaanxi during the Cultural Revolution.

author: 高建群
description_zh: 描写陕北三代人的命运与匈奴后裔的精神传承。
description_en: Depicting three generations in northern Shaanxi and the spiritual legacy of Hun descendants.

author: 孙皓晖
description_zh: 全景式展现秦国崛起统一六国的历史史诗。
description_en: A panoramic epic of Qin's rise and unification of the six states.

author: 贾平凹
description_zh: 描写进城拾荒者刘高兴的都市生存故事。
description_en: The story of Liu Gaoxing, a rural migrant scavenger surviving in the city.

author: 贾平凹
description_zh: 描写改革开放初期陕西农村的变革与动荡。
description_en: Depicting the changes and turbulence in rural Shaanxi at the beginning of reform and opening.

author: 孔尚任
description_zh: 以侯方域与李香君的爱情故事为线索，写南明覆亡的历史悲剧。
description_en: Using the love story of Hou Fangyu and Li Xiangjun to depict the fall of Southern Ming.

author: 吴敬梓
description_zh: 讽刺封建科举制度下知识分子的各种丑态与世相百态。
description_en: A satire of scholars and intellectuals under the imperial examination system.

author: 严歌苓
description_zh: 描写南京大屠杀期间秦淮河畔妓女的牺牲与救赎。
description_en: Depicting the sacrifice and redemption of Qinhuai River courtesans during the Nanjing Massacre.

author: 哈金
description_zh: 以明妮·魏特琳为原型，描写南京大屠杀中的人道主义救援。
description_en: Based on Minnie Vautrin, depicting humanitarian rescue during the Nanjing Massacre.

author: 周梅森
description_zh: 描写南京政坛风云与官场生态。
description_en: Depicting political storms and bureaucratic ecology in Nanjing.

author: 苏童
description_zh: 描写解放后两位妓女的命运变迁与改造历程。
description_en: Depicting the fate and transformation of two prostitutes after liberation.

author: 苏童
description_zh: 描写五龙从乡村到城市的挣扎与堕落。
description_en: Depicting Wulong's struggle and degradation from rural to urban life.

author: 苏童
description_zh: 描写民国大户人家四房姨太太间的明争暗斗。
description_en: Depicting the intrigues among four concubines in a wealthy family during the Republic era.

author: 苏童
description_zh: 描写父子两代人在河上漂泊的宿命人生。
description_en: Depicting the destined lives of father and son drifting on the river.

author: 苏童
description_zh: 描写香椿树街三个年轻人的命运纠葛。
description_en: Depicting the intertwined fates of three young people on Xiang Chun Shu Street.

author: 苏曼殊
description_zh: 以西湖为背景的爱情悲剧，诗僧苏曼殊的自传体小说。
description_en: A love tragedy set by West Lake, autobiographical novel by poet-monk Su Manshu.

author: 古吴墨浪子
description_zh: 描写与西湖相关的历史名人与传奇故事。
description_en: Depicting historical figures and legendary stories related to West Lake.

author: 冯梦龙
description_zh: 白娘子与许仙在西湖断桥相遇的爱情传说。
description_en: The love legend of White Snake and Xu Xian meeting at Broken Bridge of West Lake.

author: 张岱
description_zh: 张岱追忆西湖旧景的散文集，文字优美典雅。
description_en: Zhang Dai's elegant essays reminiscing about the old scenery of West Lake.

author: 张岱
description_zh: 张岱晚年追忆明末江南繁华生活的散文名作。
description_en: Zhang Dai's famous essays reminiscing about the prosperity of Jiangnan in late Ming.

author: 李贺
description_zh: 唐代诗人李贺吟咏南朝名妓苏小小的著名诗篇。
description_en: Tang poet Li He's famous poem about Southern Dynasty courtesan Su Xiaoxiao.

author: 方成培
description_zh: 白蛇传故事的戏曲版本，白娘子被镇压在雷峰塔下。
description_en: Opera version of White Snake legend, where White Snake is trapped under Leifeng Pagoda.

author: 冯梦龙
description_zh: 冯梦龙
之一，收录劝世警世的短篇故事。
description_en: One of Feng Menglong's 'Three Words', collecting moralistic short stories.

author: 冯梦龙
description_zh: 冯梦龙
之一，以故事明道理，警醒世人。
description_en: One of Feng Menglong's 'Three Words', using stories to illuminate moral principles.

author: 冯梦龙
description_zh: 冯梦龙
之一，以故事警示世人。
description_en: One of Feng Menglong's 'Three Words', using stories to caution the world.

author: 罗贯中
description_zh: 中国四大名著之一，描写三国时期的历史故事与英雄人物。
description_en: One of the Four Great Classical Novels, depicting the history and heroes of the Three Kingdoms period.

author: 诸葛亮
description_zh: 诸葛亮北伐前上呈后主刘禅的著名表章，情真意切。
description_en: Zhuge Liang's famous memorial to Liu Shan before the Northern Expedition.

author: 李白
description_zh: 李白描写蜀道艰险的著名诗篇，气势磅礴。
description_en: Li Bai's famous poem describing the perilous roads to Shu.

title_english: Poetry from Du Fu's Thatched Cottage
author: 杜甫
description_zh: 杜甫在成都草堂时期创作的诗歌，多反映民间疾苦。
description_en: Poems Du Fu wrote during his time at the Thatched Cottage in Chengdu.

title_english: My Thatched Roof is Ruined by the Autumn Wind
author: 杜甫
description_zh: 杜甫在成都草堂遭遇秋风后所作，表达忧民情怀。
description_en: Du Fu's poem after his thatched cottage was damaged by autumn wind, expressing concern for the people.

author: 赵崇祚
description_zh: 中国第一部词总集，收录五代时期词人作品。
description_en: The first anthology of ci poetry, collecting works from Five Dynasties poets.

author: 戴肇辰
description_zh: 清代官修广州地方志，记载广州历史地理文化。
description_en: Qing Dynasty official gazetteer recording Guangzhou's history, geography and culture.

author: 欧阳山
description_zh: 以广州三家巷为背景，描写大革命时期的风云变幻。
description_en: Set in Guangzhou's Three Family Lane, depicting the tumultuous Great Revolution period.

author: 黄谷柳
description_zh: 描写广州流浪儿虾球的苦难遭遇与成长历程。
description_en: Depicting the hardships and growth of Guangzhou street child Shrimp Ball.

author: 玛格丽特·杜拉斯
description_zh: 法国女作家杜拉斯的自传体小说，描写在殖民地越南与华人富商的爱情。
description_en: Duras's autobiographical novel about her love affair with a Chinese merchant in colonial Vietnam.

title_english: Six Records of a Floating Life
author: 沈复
description_zh: 沈复记录与妻子芸娘的伉俪情深及人生浮沉。
description_en: Shen Fu's memoir of his deep love with wife Yun and life's ups and downs.

author: 汤显祖
description_zh: 中国戏曲史上的巅峰之作，杜丽娘因梦生情，为情而死又因情复生。
description_en: A masterpiece of Chinese opera, Du Liniang falls in love through a dream, dies for love, and is resurrected.

title_english: The Story of the Western Wing
author: 王实甫
description_zh: 元代杂剧名作，描写崔莺莺与张生的爱情故事。
description_en: Famous Yuan Dynasty play depicting the love story of Cui Yingying and Zhang Sheng.

author: 凌濛初
description_zh: 凌濛初创作的白话短篇小说集，故事曲折离奇。
description_en: Ling Mengchu's collection of vernacular short stories with intricate plots.

author: 凌濛初
description_zh: 凌濛初
的第二部，延续奇闻异事风格。
description_en: The second part of Ling Mengchu's 'Two Slaps', continuing the style of strange tales.

title_english: Record of Buddhist Monasteries in Luoyang
author: 杨衒之
description_zh: 记载北魏洛阳城内佛寺的兴废与都城风貌。
description_en: Recording the rise and fall of Buddhist monasteries in Luoyang during Northern Wei.

title_english: A New Account of Tales of the World
author: 刘义庆
description_zh: 记录魏晋名士的言行轶事，展现魏晋风度。
description_en: Recording anecdotes of famous scholars during Wei and Jin, showing Wei-Jin style.

title_english: Rhapsody on the Goddess of the Luo River
author: 曹植
description_zh: 曹植描写洛水女神的千古名篇，文辞华美。
description_en: Cao Zhi's timeless masterpiece describing the goddess of the Luo River.

author: 汤显祖
description_zh: 汤显祖代表作，以牡丹为象征的爱情传奇。
description_en: Tang Xianzu's masterpiece, a love legend symbolized by the peony.

author: 蘅塘退士
description_zh: 清代编选的唐诗精华，流传最广的唐诗选本。
description_en: A Qing Dynasty anthology of Tang poetry, the most widely circulated collection.

author: 孟元老
description_zh: 记录北宋都城汴京的繁华盛况与市井风俗。
description_en: Recording the prosperity and customs of Bianjing, the Northern Song capital.

author: 施耐庵
description_zh: 中国四大名著之一，描写梁山108位好汉的传奇故事。
description_en: One of the Four Great Classical Novels, depicting the legendary 108 outlaws of Mount Liang.

title_english: Romance of the Yang Family Warriors
author: 熊大木
description_zh: 描写北宋杨家将抗击辽国、保家卫国的英雄故事。
description_en: Depicting the Yang family warriors' heroic fight against the Liao Dynasty in Northern Song.

author: 钱彩
description_zh: 描写南宋抗金名将岳飞的传奇人生与精忠报国。
description_en: Depicting the legendary life of Southern Song hero Yue Fei and his loyal devotion to the nation.

author: 冶文彪
description_zh: 以《清明上河图》为线索的宋代推理小说，还原汴京市井生活。
description_en: A Song Dynasty mystery novel based on 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival'.

author: 紫式部
description_zh: 世界最早的长篇小说，描写平安时代贵族光源氏的一生与爱情。
description_en: The world's first novel, depicting the life and loves of Prince Genji in the Heian period.

author: 清少纳言
description_zh: 清少纳言的随笔集，记录平安时代宫廷生活的点滴与审美。
description_en: Sei Shonagon's essays recording daily life and aesthetics of the Heian court.

author: 夏目漱石
description_zh: 以一只猫的视角讽刺明治时代知识分子的世态。
description_en: A satirical novel from a cat's perspective, mocking Meiji-era intellectuals.

author: 夏目漱石
description_zh: 探讨明治时代知识分子的孤独与自我。
description_en: Exploring the loneliness and self of Meiji-era intellectuals.

author: 夏目漱石
description_zh: 东京青年赴乡下任教的幽默故事。
description_en: A humorous story of a Tokyo youth teaching in the countryside.

author: 川端康成
description_zh: 川端康成代表作，描写雪国温泉旅馆中的唯美爱情。
description_en: Kawabata's masterpiece depicting an aesthetic love story in a snow country hot spring town.

author: 川端康成
description_zh: 描写青年学生与旅行艺人少女的纯洁邂逅。
description_en: Depicting the pure encounter between a student and a young traveling dancer.

author: 太宰治
description_zh: 太宰治的自传体小说，描写一个
的男子的堕落人生。
description_en: Dazai's autobiographical novel about a man who has lost his qualifications to be human.

author: 太宰治
description_zh: 描写战后日本没落贵族家庭的衰败与挣扎。
description_en: Depicting the decline and struggle of a fallen aristocratic family in postwar Japan.

title_english: The Temple of the Golden Pavilion
author: 三岛由纪夫
description_zh: 根据真实事件改编，描写口吃僧侣纵火焚烧金阁寺的心理历程。
description_en: Based on real events, depicting a stuttering monk's psychological journey to burning down Kinkaku-ji.

author: 川端康成
description_zh: 以京都四季为背景，描写分离多年的双胞胎姐妹的重逢。
description_en: Set against Kyoto's four seasons, depicting the reunion of twin sisters separated for years.

author: 川端康成
description_zh: 以茶道为背景，描写复杂的爱情与世代纠葛。
description_en: Set against tea ceremony, depicting complex love and generational entanglements.

author: 谷崎润一郎
description_zh: 描写大阪名门�的木家四姐妹的日常生活与婚事。
description_en: Depicting the daily life and marriages of the four Makioka sisters from an Osaka merchant family.

author: 谷崎润一郎
description_zh: 描写盲女琴师春琴与仆人佐助之间极致的爱与献身。
description_en: Depicting the extreme love and devotion between blind musician Shunkin and her servant Sasuke.

author: 谷崎润一郎
description_zh: 探讨日本传统美学中阴翳、幽暗之美。
description_en: Exploring the beauty of shadows and darkness in traditional Japanese aesthetics.

author: �的长明
description_zh: 描写隐居生活与对无常世事的感悟。
description_en: Describing hermit life and reflections on the impermanence of worldly affairs.

author: 吉田兼好
description_zh: 吉田兼好的随笔集，记录人生感悟与日常观察。
description_en: Yoshida Kenko's essays recording life reflections and daily observations.

author: 琵琶法师
description_zh: 描写平氏家族兴衰的军记物语，日本中世文学代表作。
description_en: A war tale depicting the rise and fall of the Taira clan, a masterpiece of medieval Japanese literature.

title_english: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
author: 松尾芭蕉
description_zh: 芭蕉的俳句游记，记录奥州之旅的风景与感悟。
description_en: Basho's haiku travel journal recording landscapes and reflections from his journey to the deep north.

author: 近松门左卫门
description_zh: 近松门左卫门的净琉璃代表作，描写町人与游女的殉情悲剧。
description_en: Chikamatsu's masterpiece depicting the tragic double suicide of a merchant and a courtesan.

title_english: The Life of an Amorous Man
author: 井原西鹤
description_zh: 井原西鹤的代表作，描写好色男子世之介的风流一生。
description_en: Saikaku's masterpiece depicting the amorous life of Yonosuke.

author: 井原西鹤
description_zh: 描写元禄时代大阪商人的致富故事与处世之道。
description_en: Depicting the wealth-building stories and worldly wisdom of Osaka merchants in the Genroku era.

author: 井原西鹤
description_zh: 描写町人社会中金钱与人情的纠葛。
description_en: Depicting the entanglement of money and human feelings in townspeople society.

author: 織田作之助
description_zh: 描写大阪一对相濡以沫的夫妻的生活故事。
description_en: Depicting the life story of a devoted couple in Osaka.

author: 五木宽之
description_zh: 描写战后日本青年的成长与奋斗历程。
description_en: Depicting the growth and struggles of postwar Japanese youth.
